title: Username maker
description:
A school gives every student a username made from the first letter of their first name, their whole last name, and the number of letters in the two names together.

Read a first name and a last name (two words) and print the username:

```
Grace Hopper  ->  GHopper11
```

Print only the username.
hints: `std::to_string(number)` turns a number into text so it can be joined onto a string.
Build the username in three steps with `+=`: the first letter, the last name, then the digits.
